mapper.select: SELECT r.tenant_id AS tenantId, r.id AS resultId FROM join_task_result r JOIN join_task t ON t.id = r.join_task_id AND t.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status = 'RUNNING' AND t.is_set_admin_enabled = 1 AND r.status = 'SUCCESS' AND r.admin_status IN (1, 2, 5) AND r.admin_next_execute_at <= #{now} ORDER BY r.admin_next_execute_at, r.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM join_task_result WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE join_task_result SET admin_status = #{adminStatus}, admin_command_id = #{adminCommandId}, admin_attempt_no = #{adminAttemptNo}, admin_actor_account_id = #{adminActorAccountId}, admin_next_execute_at = #{adminNextExecuteAt}, admin_deadline_at = #{adminDeadlineAt}, admin_reason = #{adminReason}, is_admin = #{admin}, promoted_at = #{promotedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND admin_status IN (1, 2, 5)
